description: This file implements the LayerMetadata class, which manages a map of metadata entries for a layer, including serialization/deserialization, merging, and string representation functions.

classes.name: LayerMetadata
classes.description: Class managing layer metadata entries with serialization, merging, and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another LayerMetadata object into this one, optionally erasing empty entries.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the LayerMetadata object into a Parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes the LayerMetadata object from a Parcel.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in the metadata map.

methods.name: getInt32
methods.description: Retrieves an int32 value associated with a key, with fallback.

methods.name: setInt32
methods.description: Sets an int32 value for a specific key.

methods.name: getInt64
methods.description: Retrieves an int64 value associated with a key, if present.

methods.name: itemToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a metadata item based on its key.
